name: SCAPEGOAT
canonical: the live scapegoat of the Day of Atonement, a lone shaggy Near-Eastern male goat with rough tawny-and-white hair, curved horns and dark sorrowful eyes, driven solitary across a barren cracked-earth wilderness bearing the confessed iniquities into a land not inhabited
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
